definition.question: How severely is commercial shipping and energy flow through the Strait of Hormuz disrupted?
definition.low_end: Strait fully open with normal traffic volumes, routine insurance pricing, and no attacks or interception risk for commercial shipping.
definition.high_end: Strait of Hormuz fully closed to commercial traffic with no transits, sustained sinkings/mining, and prolonged halt to oil and LNG flows.
